strongest_case: The strongest case is conditional on the asserted identical-weights, identical-question, only-budget contrast being real: leak_rate moves from 0.025 to 1.0 while truncation, coverage, degeneration, and echo states move in the opposite directions. That is a direct falsification of the inference 'low entity_leak means forgetting' for this frozen model, not just a speculative metric critique. Forced reachability and all-echo pilot results make the failure mode cheap and concrete: answer_reached can be 0.0 while leak_rate is 1.0, and generic judge disagreement, trace-only leakage, and non-degenerate censoring bounds are not needed to explain the pilot. The narrow paper that could still work is an evaluation protocol reporting per-sample generation state, exact match spans, conditional leak rates, and censoring/reachability bounds; the supplied full-text note says the closest verified work does not formalize those pieces.

next_experiment.name: Paired matched-budget, no-echo, reachability-controlled generation-state audit.
next_experiment.design: On one H20, using greedy decoding, fp32, and seed 1001, take the 32 forget samples and the existing 400 paraphrase probes; first verify from exact prompt text which paraphrases exclude the gold phrase, and run GPU generations only on those no-echo prompts. Run DefaultCoT and forced short-think across the supplied 192-, 512-, and 1024-token budgets, saving full prompt, full reasoning trace, final answer, exact substring match spans, answer_reached/censored, degenerate, question_echo-only, and trace/answer channel labels. Compute raw leak_rate, conditional leak rates after excluding censored/collapsed/echo-only cases, echo-free recovery, and channel_gap from the same paired outputs.
next_experiment.success_criterion: Pre-register that I01 is supported only if (a) the run produces a nonzero paired answer-reached, non-degenerate, no-echo cell for every matched budget/strategy comparison; (b) raw leak_rate changes by budget/strategy while the conditional leak label is unchanged for every paired sample in that controlled cell; and (c) at least one no-echo forced-reachability response contains the gold key phrase in the answer or reasoning trace, showing that the low-leak condition was state-confounded rather than forgetting. If (a) fails, if any paired conditional label flips, or if no no-echo recovery is observed, report I01 as unsupported or restrict the paper to a single-model metric pathology.
next_experiment.estimated_gpu_hours: ≤ 2 GPU-hours on one H20, budgeted from the supplied pilot throughput of about 2 GPU-minutes per whole batch; this is a budget bound, not a measured runtime.
